name: rapier
description: Rapier, the fast offline Markdown editor, as a Claude plugin: four skills and the MCP door.

plugins.name: rapier
plugins.description: Write, draw, paint and revise the same Markdown document with Claude. The assistant reads current passages or drawing objects before changing them. Your typing comes first; review changes and undo an assistant change while preserving later human edits. Choose FREE, CHECK or ASK to control how changes land. Text, pictures and editable drawings travel in one Markdown file. Export exact Markdown, an offline editor, plain text or a rendered web page; an open editor also supplies Word and PDF. No Rapier account, ads or tracking. Shared documents and working history stay in a private workspace that expires after 30 idle days.
